nodes.label: ADR-007 Superseded 20-Minute Day
nodes.description: The original accepted 20-real-minute game day was superseded because it felt too fast; Normal is now 40 minutes with selectable presets retaining the original as Fast.

nodes.label: Seasonal Visibility Pacing Goal
nodes.description: Compressed time is intended to make seasons, festivals, relationship evolution, and parish change visible within ordinary play while respecting inference budgets.

edges.description: Seasonal visibility and simulation pacing were the goals behind the time-scale decision even though its original default was later revised.
